pages.title: What the Phoenix leaves
pages.text: When a player slays a Phoenix, a flat block of $(item)Ash$() is left where it fell. It can be mined with a shovel or by hand.

pages.title: Rebirth
pages.text: Place the Ash next to lava (or in it) and click it with a $(item)Phoenix Feather$(). After 3 minutes the block vanishes and a calm Phoenix rises in its place.$(br2)Only that one can be tamed with a $(item)Spirit Apple$().
